question.problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & -2 \\ 1 & -1 & -1 \\ -2 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,A-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
A-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-2-\lambda  & 0 & -2 \\ 1 & -1-\lambda  & -1 \\ -2 & 0 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(A-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Expanding the determinant across the $2$nd column, we obtain the following:  

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-2-\lambda  & 0 & -2 \\ 1 & -1-\lambda  & -1 \\ -2 & 0 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-1-\lambda )|\begin{aligned}-2-\lambda  & -2 \\ -2 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-1-\lambda )((-2-\lambda )(1-\lambda )-(-2)(-2)) & =0 \\ (-1-\lambda )({\lambda }^{2}+\lambda -6) & =0 \\ (\lambda +1)(\lambda +3)(\lambda -2) & =0\end{aligned}
$$
